---
title: "ARCHY 459 Lab 2: Cleaning Lithic Artefact Data"
format: docx
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

lithic_data <- read_csv("lithics_raw.csv")

lithics_clean <-
  lithic_data |> 
  mutate(length_mm = parse_number(length_mm)) |> 
  mutate(weight_g = parse_number(weight_g)) |> 
  mutate(platform_mm = parse_number(platform_mm)) |> 
  filter(weight_g < 500)
```
